edits.find: 自每一起始之差，有一阶于每步在 c 无所失，恰当
edits.replace: 自每一起始之差，有一阶于每步在 c 皆等于可致，恰当
edits.why: Order: this 經 uses 所失, which is defined only in the 經 of ⟦十二·五⟧, a later 條. The new wording says exactly what Remainder.finite_order_iff_no_loop states: carriedWithin j t c = carried t c.

edits.find: 所以 j 阶至第 j 步皆无所失
edits.replace: 所以 j 阶至第 j 步皆等于可致（无所失；所失之名见⟦十二·五⟧）
edits.why: The 說 also uses 无所失 before ⟦十二·五⟧ defines 所失, so its first use gets a pointer to the definition. The claim itself is carriedWithin_exact.

edits.find: 一单位只给一次于第一个所待
edits.replace: 一单位只与一次于第一个所待
edits.why: Name: giving in an exchange is 与 (取与). plain-wordings asks for 给 to become 与, and the writer's own notes say 与 is used throughout.

edits.find: 每步以应倍二转给第二个所待
edits.replace: 每步以应倍二转与第二个所待
edits.why: Same fix, 给 to 与, for the giving step in Propagation.Chain.relay.

edits.find: 应倍是一环节对所读之积每单位所给者
edits.replace: 应倍是一取与对所读之积每单位所给者
edits.why: Wrong concept: 应倍 (RespondsWithin) is the strength of an exchange (取与) on a level it reads. A 环节 is a map in the return-map list, and the next clause contrasts the two. The name table says 应倍 is the 倍 an 应 gives per unit of the level it reads.

edits.find: 报处处小于所受，是充分条件
edits.replace: 报于零为零、于每一正差皆小于之，是充分条件
edits.why: Exactness: closes_within needs f 0 = 0 and f x < x for positive x. A map on Nat cannot be below what it receives at 0, so '处处小于' misstates the condition.

edits.find: 诸倍相乘为零，则首匝之后差为零；
edits.replace: 诸倍相乘为零，则自首匝起差每匝皆为零；
edits.why: whole_factors gives state (n+1) = 0 for every n, that is at every turn from the first on. '首匝之后差为零' can be read as a claim about the first turn only.

edits.find: 名“还”之回馈义始见于注层（河上公、苏辙）；
edits.replace: 名“还”之回馈义始见于注层：北宋苏辙注「必還報之」〔LC-SZ-ALL〕；王弼注读作还反无为，河上公注读作举事自责，都不是经他者而回；
edits.why: Fact: the checked passage lao-30-qi-shi-hao-huan finds that, of the three commentaries, only 苏辙 reads 好还 as a return through others. 河上公 reads it as 举事好还自责 and 王弼 as 还反无为. All three verified with ctq text: LC-SZ-ALL '必還報之', LC-HS-UP '其举事好还自责', DS01 '有道者务欲还反无为'. The quotation added is exact.

edits.find: 若法又唯读已立者：于 c 至此每步皆不下于阈之步
edits.replace: 若法又唯读已立者，所标者唯 c：于 c 至此每步皆不下于阈之步
edits.why: Hypothesis: Nonanticipating.standing_alike already needs `only` (no stock but c is marked), so the condition on the mark has to come before the first clause. '以标独标 c' was also hard to parse.

edits.replace: ；未穷之法于 c 之应倍为零
edits.why: The mark condition now stands at the head of the sentence, so it covers standing_alike, standing_unread and standing_no_loop together.

edits.replace: 而阈不少于它们于 c 之需
edits.why: Name rule: 高/低 used as a comparison becomes 多/少 (the writer applies this elsewhere). This is θ s ≥ need in Through.readsBelow.

edits.find: 凡 g 之取与经其感，他者于 g 所感之所待之取与二流皆同
edits.replace: 凡诸待者之同异定然否，g 之取与经其感，他者于 g 所感之所待之取与二流皆同
edits.why: Local condition: policy_uses_after_failure assumes [DecidableEq F]. The first law of this 經 states its [DecidableEq C] as 诸所待之同异定然否, so this law states its own condition the same way.

edits.find: 若 g 所感之一所待其差有改，则其前有一步原网不容 g。
edits.replace: 若 g 所感之一所待其差至某步有改，则非此前每步原网皆容 g。
edits.why: Exactness: the Lean conclusion is ¬ ∀ s < t, W.Supported s g. The core assumes no excluded middle, and 'there is an earlier step where g is unsupported' is the stronger existential, which Lean does not prove.
